page.overview:
What is Leavanny?

Leavanny is a thin, yellow, bipedal humanoid-looking insect Pokémon which is supposed to resemble a leaf insect. It has a broad, split leaf around its head and has long antennae protruding from it which end in semi-circles. Its chest and legs are dark green and sectioned. The hands look like leaves and the arms are like veins. Its abdomen is covered by its leafy tail, making it look like it is wearing a cloak. It has a string that it uses for the trail to come out of mazes.

Leavanny is a very kind, motherly, nurturing Pokémon. It will weave leafy clothing for small Pokémon, including its young, Sewaddle.

Leavanny evolves from Swadloon if leveled up with high friendship and is the final evolution of Sewaddle.

Leavanny shares similarities with . It may also be based on a or , both of which cover themselves with leaves as shelter. It also shares similarities to a mother or babysitter as it is often caring of small Pokémon and also wraps its baby Sewaddle in bonnet-like leaves.
